notes.title: Lamia's News January 2025 Issue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676282/be1199bc9e511215b5bce0f76a5e40628e2d9f1f.png[/img]
[h1]Lamias News January 2025 Issue[/h1]

2025 is the "Year of the Snake", so we will be releasing Lamia's News at the end of every month!

Japan has a zodiac sign, and the zodiac sign for 2025 is the snake.

Studio Dragonet will be releasing exciting information, mainly about "Lamias Bambina", which is currently in development, so please look forward to it!

[h2]What is Lamiban? [/h2]
New information in this issue! ...But first, we have prepared a video for those of you who are wondering what Lamiban is.
[previewyoutube=CspnGCLZ0V8;full][/previewyoutube]
In other words, it's a type of RPG where you increase the number of allies and conquer dungeons.

[h3]The Story of Lamiban[/h3]
Ivy, who has been reincarnated in the demon world, aims to revive the Lamia tribe with Princess Hedera.
The player controls Ivy to increase, raise, and fight Lamia,
and recapture Lamia Palace from the Harpies.
The rise and fall of the Lamia tribe depends on this battle. Let's go, Lamiban!

[h2]Summoning System[/h2]
In this issue, we'll introduce you to the [b]Summoning System[/b],
how to increase the number of allies in Lamia's Bambina (hereafter Lamiban)!
Click here for the video.
[previewyoutube=ikDFJe-PvSQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Everyone loves gacha! Gacha!
So, to increase the number of Lamia allies, you need to gacha!
Ah, it's not gacha, it's summoning.

Each summoning formula will summon a unique lamia with a certain probability.
Of course, you can add the summoned lamia to your party and go on an adventure.
Each lamia has different characteristics:
・Easiness of developing each parameter
・Magic you can use
・Passive skills
・Body color

Summon them and find your favorite lamia!
[u][b]Ah, summoning is completed with in-game money, so no additional real money is required! [/b][/u]

So does that mean Lamiban is a game of luck based on the strength of your companions?
If you're not sure,
then.
We'll announce ways to increase your companions other than summoning in the February issue. Check it out!

That's all for this issue. Look forward to the end of next month!
Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!
